flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000 then save an item named eggs
then delete eggs using its Delete button
and verify eggs is no longer in the list

remark: type: Typing eggs into the Item field
click: Clicking Save button to add eggs
wait: PRIMARY: wait briefly after hovering the eggs list item
agent_info: The eggs list item exists, but the page exposes only a Save button and no Delete

summary:
The list shows saved items without providing the required Delete control, so eggs cannot be removed through the page.
Add a Delete button for each list item and verify that selecting it removes the corresponding item from the list.
evidence: objective_contradiction: The eggs list item exists, but the page exposes only a Save button and no Delete button.
one_liner: The item was saved, but there was no Delete button available to remove it.
